mapper.select: SELECT REPT_NUMB , USER_NUMB , BOOK_TITL FROM ( SELECT R.REPT_NUMB , R.USER_NUMB , B.BOOK_TITL FROM TM_REPORT R INNER JOIN TM_BKINFO B ON B.BOOK_NUMB = R.BOOK_NUMB INNER JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB INNER JOIN TB_ALTEMP T ON T.ALIM_SITU = #{alimSituReport} AND T.TEMP_CODE = #{tempCodeReportDateOver} AND T.USEE_YSNO = #{commYes} WHERE R.REPT_STAT = #{reportStatRead} AND R.REPT_ENDT IS NOT NULL AND R.REPT_ENDT >= TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{lookbackDays}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND R.REPT_ENDT <= TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TRIM(B.BOOK_TITL) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_ALIMXX A WHERE A.USER_NUMB = R.USER_NUMB AND A.ALIM_SITU = T.ALIM_SITU AND A.TEMP_CODE = T.TEMP_CODE AND A.LINK_URLX = T.LINK_URLX || TO_CHAR(R.REPT_NUMB) ) ORDER BY R.REPT_ENDT ASC , R.REPT_NUMB ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{maxSize}
